name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_create_session
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnCreateSession validates the player name, routes non-modem sessions to host setup, and creates an immediate modem DirectPlay session when requested. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches MFC CDialog::OnOK ordinal 4853 and USER32 KillTimer, and patches accepted authored callees so the branch behavior is isolated.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b5a0 validates the thiscall ABI, ValidatePlayerName early return, non-modem KillTimer(hwnd, 2) and m_shouldEnterHostSetup assignment, modem status fields eventCode 256/statusFlags 0/valueOrTime 10/auxParam 10/maxPlayers 2/sessionName ModemSession, success-only network/modem enablement and local-player creation, and direct CDialog::OnOK when m_shouldEnterHostSetup is nonzero.

The native smoke verifies invalid-name early return, non-modem host setup and timer stop, modem CreateSession failure without closing, and modem CreateSession success with status-field contents, network/modem option updates, local player creation from zOpt_GetPlayerName, and OnOK dispatch.
